lines.trans: Ow! Something sharp poked into my foot!
What is that there? Is it a screw?
Yes, a screw from the old floor.
My goodness! What an idiot I am!
Arkasha, what has happened to you?
I forgot to say the main thing!
I needed to tell Marina urgently!
Wait! Where are you running off to?
Wait here! I'll be right back.
Marina! Where is Marina?
Why are you shouting at the whole house?
Klavdia Viktorovna, where is Marina?
She's at the hospital, with Lyokha having surgery.
What do you mean, surgery? Good grief, what a nightmare!
How stupid I am!
